title: AutoBarcoder: 96-well plate RNA barcode demultiplexing and clustering
description: Developed in the Parvez Lab, Northwestern University Feinberg School of Medicine. AutoBarcoder is a Python tool for demultiplexing and clustering RNA barcodes from 96-well-plate sequencing reads. It uses Levenshtein distance and connected-components clustering (NetworkX) to group similar barcodes per well, and ships a Tkinter GUI, FastAPI web UI, and an interactive setup wizard.
